subject.title: fix(extensions): bound extension source read with size cap

question: Should a symlinked extension source retain its previous native-import eligibility, or is routing every symlinked source through Jiti an accepted compatibility change?
rationale: The replacement helper deliberately rejects symlinks, which changes the decision input used by the native-versus-Jiti loader path; repository history and the current extension-path contract need an owner decision.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Adjust the bounded-read approach so supported symlinked extension sources retain their prior routing, and add a focused regression test.

options.title: Accept Jiti routing for symlinks
options.body: Document that symlinked extension sources intentionally use Jiti and add coverage proving the supported behavior remains reliable.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
recommendation.body: Adjust the bounded-read approach so supported symlinked extension sources retain their prior routing, and add a focused regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: A named owner could not be established from the supplied review context without guessing; route through the extension-loader history.
